goals: Add a deterministic full-suite integration gate to the run finalization in src/scheduler/codex-batch.ts. After all tasks are accepted and merged into the integration worktree, run a bounded set of gate commands (safe default: npm test then npm run build) in the integration worktree before computing allAccepted. If any gate command exits non-zero, the run must report allAccepted false and status blocked, record a structured gate-failure record (each command, exit code and bounded log tail) in the returned result and the run evidence, and leave every accepted task verdict untouched. The gate runs as a plain shell command, never through a model, and must not rewrite accepted-task verdicts or evidence. Preserve the per-task focused verifyCommands exactly. Add tests proving: all tasks accepted plus a green gate yields allAccepted true and status completed; all tasks accepted plus a red gate yields allAccepted false, status blocked and a gate-failure record while task verdicts stay accepted; and a dependency-skip already yields allAccepted false without invoking the gate.
nonGoals: Do not route the gate through a model.
Do not change per-task focused verifyCommands.
Do not rewrite accepted task verdicts on gate failure.
deliverables: A deterministic full-suite integration gate before finalization.
Structured gate-failure evidence without verdict mutation.
forbidden: Do not call a model to run the gate.
Do not mutate accepted task verdicts on gate failure.
Do not run an unbounded or interactive gate command.
